verdict.rationale: Base44 documents its own programmatic surfaces for creating and managing apps. These are a CLI that creates projects, syncs, deploys and runs commands against any app on the account, plus an official MCP server that exposes the account to AI assistants. However, no documented platform HTTP API appears in the evidence (OpenAPI probes all 404), and the SDK only covers in-app data CRUD. Programmatic prompt-to-app generation via an API is also not evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP management API with reference/OpenAPI spec, API-driven AI app generation from prompts, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API

citations.quote: Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app on your account
The Base44 MCP server exposes your Base44 account to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
Install Base44 skills and let your AI coding agent create, build, and deploy a new Base44 project on your machine.
